# Generated by crates/query/tests/cross_type_matrix.rs. Do not hand-edit:
#   UPDATE_EXPECT=1 cargo test -p powdb-query --test cross_type_matrix
#
# Fixture: one row with every column populated (each holding "one" in its
# own type) and one row that is null in every column. Each cell is the row
# count returned by `count(X filter .<column> <op> <literal>)`, so 1 means
# the populated row matched, 0 means nothing matched, and ERR(...) means the
# comparison was refused. The null row must never match, including under
# `!=`: that is PowDB's documented two-valued NULL rule.
#
# Every cell is evaluated with the executor fast paths on and again with
# them forced off. They must agree; a disagreement is written as
# DIVERGED(...) and fails the test.
#
# Every cell is also evaluated with a plain and with a unique index on
# the column, at each path setting. An index must never change the
# answer; one that does is written as INDEX_DIVERGED(...).
#
# column   op   literal        result
